profile.headline: Engineer | Technical Leader | Critical Thinker & Problem Solver
profile.summary:
Experienced Software professional with 15+ years of progressive experience in designing, building, and optimizing large-scale SaaS/PaaS cloud services, combining technical expertise with leadership

Extensive experience leading and developing collaboration products, delivering high-impact, metrics-driven features that improve performance, reliability, and user experience

Service Owner  overseeing development and operations of the Cisco Webex Meetings microservice, supporting 250M+ meeting minutes daily. Results-driven Scrum Master with expertise in managing sprint lifecycles, mid-term backlog planning, and fostering high-performing cross-functional teams through effective mentorship 

Recognized for mentorship and collaboration, leading design reviews, enablement sessions, and guidance to accelerate delivery

Experience in in Python, C++, Java, REST API, Distributed Systems and Microservices, AI technologies, Proficiency with AI Coding Assistants (Github Copilot)

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
Technical Leader on Cisco Webex Meetings 

- Versatile Technical Leader with experience as Service Owner, SRE Lead, and full-stack developer, managing microservices hosting 250M+ meeting minutes daily.
- Boosted call density 10x (75 → 800 calls/node) via multithreading, memory, REST API, and media traffic optimizations and led customer migration effort in cost-neutral fashion.”
- Designed call preservation strategies, reducing disruptions by 20% with seamless failover and incremental traffic migration with built-in rollback.
- Enhanced media performance with TCP rate adaptation, reducing recovery time by 65% (73s → 25s) and improving user experience during network fluctuations.
- Spearheaded high-impact initiative for phased traffic migration of complex call flows with 0 incidents, moving 75% of service traffic to a bypass path with incremental rollout and built-in rollback mechanisms to ensure stability and minimize disruption.
- Initial developer on Media Quality Analyzer, aggregating real-time metrics from multiple microservices for KPI monitoring by executives, now used by Customer Engineering.
- Led high-impact global deployments including Saudi, Brazil, and FedRAMP clusters, ensuring compliance, stability, and readiness for production in high-visibility business initiatives.
- Designed and implemented various collaboration features such as immersive presenter overlay, multiple simultaneous shares, and cross-org policy enforcement for meeting policy compliance
- Addressed critical security vulnerabilities, including RTP bleed.

Technologies: C++, Python, gRPC, Protobuf, Kafka, Kibana, Grafana, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, GitHub, Microservices, REST API, WebSocket

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
TreasuryTrader is a cross-product treasury solution. It gives traders and managers a competitive advantage through on-line, real-time control of risk and exposure within and across all markets. The solution operates in real-time throughout with position updating, P/L revaluation, limit monitoring and risk management ensure that traders make accurate decisions based on current information and that risk managers' control of trading activity is based on fact.

Environment: C, C++, Windows, UNIX - Solaris, Multi-threading, Sun Studio, Sybase, ClearCase, Rational Quantify, Rational Purify, Sun Analyzer

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
TeamCenter Engineering is a Product lifecycle management (PLM) application which manages the entire lifecycle of a product from its conception, through design, manufacture and data management. 
It capture, manage and synchronize product design data, then automate the engineering change, validation and approval processes. The primary area of work was Product data management (PDM) which is used to manage, track and control data related to a particular product. The information may include engineering data such as CAD models, drawings, documents or other information of the parts used to create a final product.

Environment: C, C++, VC++, Java and JavaScript, XML, ASP.NET, Visual Studio .NET, Perl, Rational ClearCase, Oracle, TC - ITK's

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developer in C/C++, JAVA, JavaScript, ClearCase, Oracle for Siemens PLM product TeamCenter Engineering

positions.description: C/C++ developer on Windows environment with MS SQL, MS Access data bases for a product managing production and sales of Windows in Europe
